result.instructions: Tools for KiotViet, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are running low on stock at the Hanoi branch?"; "Show today's invoices with their totals and payment status."; "Find the customer with phone number 0901234567 and list their latest orders.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes KiotViet data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kiotviet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kiotviet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kiotviet_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. kiotviet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (code, barcode, name, category, base price, units, attributes). Optionally include stock per branch (include_inventory) and price-book prices. Filter by name, category, branch, active flag or last change. GET /products.

category_id.description: Only products in this category (see kiotviet_list_categories).

include_inventory.description: Include the stock on hand per branch.

last_modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this date-time (shop local time).

current_item.description: Record offset to start from (0 = first record). Pass the previous reply's next_item.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id: code, barcode, name, category, base price, units, attributes, images, stock per branch and price books. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_product_by_code
tools.title: Get product by code
tools.description: One product by its product code (SKU). GET /products/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List product categories (id, name, parent, whether it has children). Set hierarchical to get the category tree. GET /categories.

last_modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this date-time (shop local time).

current_item.description: Record offset to start from (0 = first record). Pass the previous reply's next_item.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_category
tools.title: Get category
tools.description: One product category by id (name, parent, children). GET /categories/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (code, name, phone, email, address, debt, total invoiced, reward points, groups). Contains personal data of the shop's customers. Filter by code, name, phone, group or last change. GET /customers.

group_id.description: Only customers in this customer group.

include_total.description: Include financial totals (debt, total invoiced, points).

last_modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this date-time (shop local time).

current_item.description: Record offset to start from (0 = first record). Pass the previous reply's next_item.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_customer

tools.name: kiotviet_get_customer_by_code
tools.title: Get customer by code
tools.description: One customer by customer code. GET /customers/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer in the shop (name required; code is generated by KiotViet if omitted). Always check with the user first, and look the customer up by phone before creating a duplicate. POST /customers.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices (code, date, branch, customer, total, amount paid, status, lines). Filter by branch, customer, status, order, purchase-date range or last change. GET /invoices.

customer_code.description: Only invoices of the customer with this code.

order_id.description: Only the invoice created from this sales order.

last_modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this date-time (shop local time).

current_item.description: Record offset to start from (0 = first record). Pass the previous reply's next_item.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id with its lines, payments and delivery. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_invoice_by_code
tools.title: Get invoice by code
tools.description: One invoice by invoice code (for example HD000123). GET /invoices/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders (code, date, branch, customer, total, status, lines, delivery). Filter by branch, customer, status, creation date (from) or last change (from/to). GET /orders.

customer_code.description: Only orders of the customer with this code.

sale_channel_id.description: Only orders from this sales channel.

created_date.description: Only orders created at or after this date.

last_modified_to.description: Only orders last changed up to this date-time (KiotViet toDate is a bound on the modification time, not the creation time). Use with last_modified_from.

last_modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this date-time (shop local time).

current_item.description: Record offset to start from (0 = first record). Pass the previous reply's next_item.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_order

tools.name: kiotviet_get_order_by_code
tools.title: Get sales order by code
tools.description: One sales order by order code (for example DH000123). GET /orders/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_create_order
tools.title: Create sales order
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales order (an order, not an invoice: no invoice is made and no payment is recorded) with lines of existing products in a branch, for an existing customer or none. Always confirm the products, quantities and prices with the user first. POST /orders.

branch_id.description: Branch the order is for (see kiotviet_list_branches).
